title: Default theme
body:
**Summary**

Linked to #2193

Build now export two more files: `instantsearch-theme-algolia.css` and `instantsearch-theme-algolia.min.css`

The theme is a port of `react-instantsearch-theme-algolia.css` to fit with the actual DOM of is.js widgets.
